decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the east elevation of the conservatory extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western or eastern flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of roof to existing 2 storey extension and proposed single storey rear conservatory to existing dwellinghouse.
